summary: Shell plc filed a Form 6-K reporting its daily share buybacks for cancellation on 01 and 02 April 2026 as part of an existing buyback programme announced 05 February 2026. The programme has on-market and off-market limbs, with Morgan Stanley & Co. International plc making independent trading decisions within preset parameters. Shares were purchased on LSE, Chi-X, BATS, XAMS, CBOE DXE, and TQEX. This is a routine capital return to shareholders. The filing does not include a price per share, premium, or close date. No special-situation event is announced.
